name: Haohua Chemical Science & Technology Corp., Ltd.
summary: Haohua Chemical Science & Technology Corp., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sales of manufactures and sells fluorine materials, electronic gases, high-end manufacturing chemical materials, and carbon emission reduction products in China and internationally. The company offers fluorocarbon chemicals, fluoropolymers, fine fluorochemicals, and fluorinated lithium battery materials; refrigerants, fire extinguishing agents, fluoropolymers, fluororubber, fluorinated intermediates, electrolytes, etc.; and nitrogen trifluoride, sulfur hexafluoride, carbon tetrafluoride, and fluorine.
